summary: Iteration 3 testing of Emergent Upsell CRM — Coverage analytics + Sticky ownership + Reopen + Region. Backend: 35/35 pytest cases pass (added 7 new: coverage admin-only/403, coverage totals + APAC won + tiers/regions/burnup shape, lead region create/update via PUT, sticky ownership Won-lock + auto-route meeting to existing owner + round-robin 400 'lock' block, reopen lead Cross-sell -> Follow-up Later + cycles++ + audit log reopen_lead, reopen requires owner -> 400, payment complete -> owner_locked=True + total_revenue_usd += amount/85 + deals_won=1). Frontend: Coverage page (/coverage) renders 4 KPI cards (Total Accounts, Coverage Owned, Won%, Revenue USD), tier-metric-spend/ltv toggle, 6 region-row-* rows, recharts SVGs all rendering. nav-coverage hidden for agents and /coverage redirects them home; campaigns/team/audit/coverage nav properly admin-gated. Lead Detail shows '🔒 Locked to owner' badge for Won leads, lifetime-revenue card with deals/cycles count, region-select edits persist, reopen-btn -> reopen-modal -> Cross-sell -> Follow-up Later with cycles incremented and 'New Cross-sell routed to {owner}' toast. CRITICAL BUG FOUND + FIXED: LeadDetail.js called setFxRate() but never declared the corresponding useState — caused runtime overlay 'ReferenceError: setFxRate is not defined' that blocked the meeting/reopen/region modals. Added `const [fxRate, setFxRate] = useState(85);`.
action_items: Self-verify: open a Won lead -> Reopen modal -> Cross-sell -> confirm stage=Follow-up Later and cycles++ (already verified by testing agent).

Optional: investigate why UI lead-create modal occasionally completes without lead appearing in list (likely required-field validation silently failing); backend POST /api/leads with region works via pytest and curl, just an edge in the create modal default values. Not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: LeadDetail.js was missing `useState` for fxRate but invoked setFxRate inside the settings fetch (line 56) and rendered {fxRate} in the FX preview (line 418). Bundle threw ReferenceError on every Lead Detail mount, surfacing as a full-page red overlay that blocked book-meeting / reopen / region-edit interactions. Patched: added const [fxRate, setFxRate] = useState(85).
Coverage endpoint correctly group_stats by tier (spend OR ltv) and region; burnup buckets weekly cumulative — with all-seed-now data we got 1 point as expected.
Sticky ownership: meetings POST routes to lead.owner_id when agent_id is omitted; round-robin returns 400 with 'Lead is locked to {owner}'. ✓
Reopen sets stage='Follow-up Later', priority='Follow-up This Week', payment_status='none', $inc upsell_cycles by 1, owner_id unchanged, audit log entry 'reopen_lead' written. ✓
_apply_payment_status sets owner_locked=True + won_at and increments total_revenue_usd by amount_usd (which is amount/fx for INR). Verified: 8500 INR @ fx=85 -> +$100 USD on lead.total_revenue_usd. ✓
server.py is now ~1040 lines — strong candidate for router split (leads.py, meetings.py, payments.py, coverage.py) as the next refactor.
Seed creates Won APAC lead w/ owner_locked=True + seeded paid $2500 payment + region on all 8 leads; coverage totals reflect this on a fresh DB.
Carry-over: CORS allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials=True; unpaginated list endpoints — same as iter1/2.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% — Coverage page, role-based nav, /coverage redirect, lead detail (locked badge, lifetime-revenue, region edit, reopen modal end-to-end with toast + state assertions) all verified; lead-create modal occasionally did not persist (likely default-field validation in the create form), but backend POST /api/leads with region works and region-select on the detail page works.

rca of the issue: CRITICAL: LeadDetail.js called setFxRate (line 56) and read fxRate (line 418) without declaring the useState. React threw ReferenceError on every detail page mount, rendered as a Webpack DevServer red overlay that hijacked clicks, making 'book meeting', 'reopen', 'region edit' modals appear non-functional in Playwright (Timeout: meet-datetime / reopen-type not found). Root cause: setFxRate hook was deleted during the concurrent iter3 edits but its usages remained. Mitigation: added `const [fxRate, setFxRate] = useState(85);` at the top of the component. Re-tested -> reopen flow now completes end-to-end with 'Cross-sell cycle opened — routed to owner Aryan' in the activity timeline.
